openFindings.title: The packet's ledger, acceptance evidence and task state are unwritten at HEAD
verify rejects a leading-zero 4-part version that gate, apply and the format regex accept
openFindings.description: verifyVersion fails a version whose normalized tuple equals itself but whose raw string is non-canonical (leading zeros), and apply cannot normalize it.
openFindings.scopeProof: Single comparison site in verifyVersion; applyVersion raw-equality check is its counterpart. No other mode compares tuples against raw strings.

openFindings.title: A valueless version key is treated as missing; bump then writes a duplicate version line
openFindings.description: An empty version value is treated as a missing key and bump synthesizes a second version key instead of reporting it as malformed.
openFindings.scopeProof: Any doc where the version key exists with an empty value reaches the same insert path; the earlier malformed rule already blocks non-empty invalid values, so this is the one malformed shape that slips past it.

openFindings.title: Rename below git's similarity threshold is an add; a rewritten body raises nothing
openFindings.description: When git cannot pair a move below the similarity threshold, the body change under the moved path is never considered for a raise.
openFindings.scopeProof: The same add path covers copies and any rename git declines to pair; changedDocs and the bump loop are the only consumers of the diff.

openFindings.title: A newline in a staged doc path silently skips the raise staging
openFindings.description: A raised path containing a newline never reaches the index, and the gate cannot see it because verification runs only on the split fragments.

openFindings.title: Symlinks defeat the containment checks; the bump write has no containment check at all
openFindings.description: A symlinked worktree path passes lexical containment and the write follows it outside the skills tree.

openFindings.title: The CI version check executes the pull request's own engine
openFindings.description: The enforcing code is loaded from the untrusted change under test, so the check can be neutered by the same PR it evaluates.

openFindings.title: The 22-doc frontmatter addition is not traceable to a recorded amendment of frozen D1
Three hand-synced scope copies claim to mirror one another and diverge on two classes; no parity gate binds them
